addDrive.title: Add Drive
addDrive.description: Enter your Cloudreve site URL to connect
addDrive.waitingDescription: Complete the sign-in process in your browser to connect your drive.
addDrive.finalSetupDescription: Choose a local folder where your cloud drive will be mounted.
addDrive.localPathTipsMac: Use an absolute path starting with /. Prefer an empty or dedicated folder.
addDrive.localPathTipsWin: Use a path like D:\CloudDrive or click Browse.
addDrive.localPathTipsOther: Use an absolute path. Click Browse if unsure.
addDrive.step1Body: Enter your Cloudreve site URL (HTTPS), then connect.
addDrive.step2Body: Sign in and approve in the browser. Keep this window open.
addDrive.step3Body: Choose a display name and a local folder for synced files.
addDrive.waitingDeepLinkMac: If login succeeds but this page does not advance, use a built .app or reopen the link after the app is running (macOS dev limitation).
addDrive.reauthorizeDescription: Click confirm to update your credentials for this drive.
addDrive.reauthorizeWaitingHint: Sign in with the same account in the browser to refresh credentials.
